# 🚀 Lightning Speed FPS

> **"Lightning speed FPS. Lightweight. Scalable by default."**

Welcome to the ultimate performance-first Minecraft experience. This modpack is meticulously engineered to squeeze every single frame out of your hardware, ensuring buttery-smooth gameplay even on low-end machines.

Whether you want a competitive edge or just want to crank up your visuals without destroying your FPS, this pack has your back.

---

## ⚡ Key Features

* **Next-Gen Optimization:** Powered by **Sodium**, **ImmediatelyFast**, **FerriteCore**, and **BadOptimizations** to eliminate micro-stutters and drastically reduce memory usage.
* **Smart Resource Management:** Features **Dynamic FPS** to automatically reduce hardware strain when the game is minimized or idle.
* **Built-in Replay Abilities:** Capture your finest moments seamlessly with **Flashback**.
* **Enhanced Vanilla Visuals:** Subtle, lightweight improvements like **Better Lanterns**, **Vanilla Glowing Ores**, and **Fresh Animations** keep the game looking alive without sacrificing a single frame.
* **AmbientSounds:**  Brings the world to life with birds chirping, wind howling, and dynamic cave echoes.
---

## 🎨 Shaders & Scalability (Optional)

By default, this pack is configured for raw, unadulterated speed. However, if your hardware has room to breathe and you want a gorgeous visual upgrade, we’ve got you covered:

* **MakeUp - Ultra Fast Shaders** are included but **disabled by default**.
* **How to enable:** Simply go to your video settings, navigate to the **Iris Shaders** menu, and turn on *MakeUp - Ultra Fast* to enjoy stunning lighting and shadows with a incredibly minimal performance hit.

![MakeUp - Ultra Fast Enabled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9cd0473cd996a771c644a091db5fe40d1c763d90.jpeg)
> Enable your MakeUp Ultra Fast Shaders to get stunning realistic sceneries!

---

## 📦 Complete Mod List

For transparency, here is the full breakdown of the performance engines and lightweight visual enhancements keeping this pack running at warp speed:

### Performance & Core Engines

| Mod Name | Creator | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Sodium** | CaffeineMC | Modern rendering engine replacement that drastically improves FPS. |
| **ImmediatelyFast** | RaphiMC | Optimizes immediate mode rendering to boost UI and entity performance. |
| **BadOptimizations** | thosea | Fixes various micro-stutters and minor vanilla rendering bottlenecks. |
| **FerriteCore** | malte0811 | Significantly reduces RAM usage so you can play longer and smoother. |
| **Dynamic FPS** | juliand665 | Drops background frame rates to save your CPU/GPU when tabbed out. |
| **Iris Shaders** | coderbot | Fast, modern shader support compatible with Sodium. |

### Visuals & Resource Packs

| Mod/Pack Name | Creator | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **MakeUp - Ultra Fast** *(Disabled)* | KDXavier | High-performance shader built for maximum beauty and minimum lag. |
| **Fresh Animations** | FreshLX | Adds dynamic, expressive movement to Minecraft's mobs. |
| **Prime's HD Textures FREE** | prime_mods | Crisp 32x texturing that retains the classic Minecraft feel. |
| **Better Lanterns** | Nico4play | Cleaner, 3D-enhanced visual models for lanterns. |
| **Better Lights** | PystoyPlayer | Improved, smoother block light rendering. |
| **Motschen's Better Leaves** | Motschen | Better Leaves adds additional layers to leaf blocks, making them appear more bushy, dense and natural. |  
| **Vanilla Glowing Ores** | sniffercraft34 | Makes ores emit a subtle glow, perfect for deep cave mining. |
| **AmbientSounds** | creativemd | Brings the world to life with birds chirping, wind howling, and dynamic cave echoes.|
| **Sound Physics Remastered** | henkelmax | Brings a whole new layer of immersion to your world with realistic sound attenuation, reverberation, and echo effects. Sound now dynamically bounces, muffles, and absorbs depending on the blocks surrounding you (e.g., deep caves sound echoey, while wool-lined rooms muffle sound)|

### Quality of Life & Libraries

| Mod Name | Creator | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Flashback** | Moulberry | Lightweight tool for recording and replaying your gameplay. |
| **Mod Menu** | Terraformers | Adds an easy-to-use menu to view and configure installed mods. |
| **Reese's Sodium Options** | FlashyReese | Upgrades the Sodium options menu into a clean, searchable UI. |
| **Sodium Extra** | FlashyReese | Adds missing vanilla features (like animations and particle toggles) back to Sodium. |
| **Cloth Config API** | shedaniel | Configuration screen API required by various mods. |
| **Fabric API & Language Kotlin** | modmuss50 | Core dependencies to keep the modpack stable and unified. |
| **Text Placeholder API** | Patbox | String parsing library used for custom text interfaces. |
